record.question: Choose the option which is closest in meaning to officious.
record.explanation: Answer A: pushing. “Officious” describes intrusive, unwanted forwardness; “pushing” is closest. Independent check: “Officious” means annoyingly eager to offer unwanted help; “pushing” is the closest offered synonym. Reference: https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/officious; https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/officious. Verified worked solution, unofficial.
